<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-DEV-004</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Devices</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Charts look empty; **Latest telemetry** shows a 1970 date</b></div></div>

## Why it happens

SENTIENT timestamps are milliseconds since 1 January 1970 UTC. A timestamp in seconds, such as `1730880000`, is read as a moment in January 1970, so charts of the last day show nothing.

## Fix it

Multiply the device's `ts` by 1000, or leave `ts` out and let SENTIENT use the time the message arrives.

## Check that it worked

New values show today's date on the **Latest telemetry** tab.
